transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm calling this routine daily communications planning huddle to order. We have channels C1 through C4 available for next-day routine coordination, and the signal shop can configure channels and power settings before 1800 today. Before I publish the binding communications configuration, I need each of you -- operations, logistics, maintenance, and airfield representatives -- to report your current requirements. The standard plan uses C1 for command, C2 for logistics, C3 for clinic support, and C4 for airfield services. If anyone needs adjustments to that, now is the time to speak up.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a change to the command net. The battalion coordination directive confirmed this morning requires the command net to use C2 from 0600 to 1000 tomorrow. I received the directive after the morning briefing, and the communications slide has not yet been updated. This means C2 will be tied up for command during that window, so we'll need to work out an alternate arrangement for logistics during those hours.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a logistics constraint. I confirmed from the issued-battery ledger that only R3 has enough battery capacity to support the logistics yard tomorrow, and R3 must be configured at low power from 0700 to 1100. The ledger reconciliation is still awaiting posting to the signal work queue, so this may not be on the signal shop's radar yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance constraint. My maintenance test found that R1 must be taken offline for firmware validation from 1200 to 1400 tomorrow, so clinic support during that period must use R2. This test result is still on my technician worksheet and hasn't been entered into the network status board yet, so it may not be on anyone's radar. Since the standard plan assigns C3 to clinic support, we need to make sure R2 is properly configured to carry C3 during that 1200-1400 window.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag an airfield constraint. Airfield calibration activity will make C4 unavailable at the airfield tomorrow, so airfield services must use C3 at 25 watts and complete an interference check before 0800. The airfield notice was signed after the last signal update and has not been added to the configuration packet. This means airfield services cannot use the standard C4 assignment and will need C3 instead, which conflicts with the clinic support assignment on C3.
transcript.speaker: A5

settlement.instructions: Use exact scalar values. command_channel is the primary command channel during the required window; command_revert_channel is separate. logistics_power must be exactly 'low'; logistics_window is separate. clinic_repeater is the required fallback repeater during the outage; clinic_normal_repeater is separate. Set each control field to a boolean. interference_check_deadline may be '0800' or 'before 0800'.

commitments.detail: Configure C2 for command net from 0600 to 1000 tomorrow per battalion coordination directive; revert command to C1 after 1000.
Configure R3 at low power for logistics yard from 0700 to 1100; assign logistics to C1 as fallback during 0600-1000 while C2 is used for command.
Configure R2 to carry C3 for clinic support during 1200-1400 while R1 is offline for firmware validation.
Configure C3 at 25 watts for airfield services; airfield must complete interference check before 0800. Coordinate C3 sharing between airfield and clinic support.
Update communications configuration packet and slide to reflect all changes before 1800 today.

transcript.speaker: A1
